basis_note: Reads across this case's full built chain - DFAPTI (51 evidence items), DFAPTA (15 paths), Lattice Atlas (four load-bearing nodes, three emergent patterns), SHM Gate (6 mechanisms applied, 2 candidate new mechanisms), Temporal Projection Integrity Engine (4 assessments), Enforcement Notice (4 remedies, 3 primary recipients), and Advocacy Package - plus this repository's own ingestion decisions (DEC-0001, DEC-0002) and contradiction findings (CTR-0001, CTR-0002).

functions.name: Enforcement
functions.definition: The methodology produces findings with evidentiary discipline sufficient to route to bodies with standing.
functions.match_note: A submission-ready Enforcement Notice exists, naming Kempsey Shire Council, Michael Kemp MP and NSW Crown Lands with four binding remedies - though whether it has actually been sent is itself an open, preserved contradiction (CTR-0002).

functions.name: Translation
functions.definition: Converts inaccessible governance documentation into findings legible to the people governed by it.
functions.match_note: AR-004 (Transfer Eligibility Analysis) translates the Roads Act 1993 and Crown Lands Policy IND-O-250 into a single plain finding: council's own maintenance activity has been continuously triggering transfer eligibility it has never used.

functions.name: Pattern Detection
functions.definition: Documents a convergence across actors that no single actor can see.
functions.match_note: Lattice Atlas's primary convergence finding, the Mutual Non-Action Architecture (LP-010), is visible only by reading council's maintenance records, Crown Lands' own transfer policy, and the resident's complaint pathway together - no single record shows it alone.

functions.name: Power Redistribution
functions.definition: Makes investigative power portable to any operator, no institutional backing required.
functions.status: Active - this case is a direct instance
functions.match_note: This case originates from a complete investigation the operator conducted independently in 2026, with no institutional backing, producing a full evidentiary chain through Enforcement Notice against a council and a state land agency.

functions.name: Lived Experience Protection
functions.definition: Classifies lived experience as primary evidence; institutional dismissal becomes a finding.
functions.match_note: EV-0002 and EV-0003 record the operator's own direct observational statements as a Bellbrook resident with direct access to the laneway, classified in this case's register as primary evidence rather than anecdote.

functions.name: Legibility
functions.definition: Makes governance instruments understandable to the people they govern.
functions.match_note: AR-001 and AR-004 together make legible what has never been documented anywhere publicly: that the laneway's tenure is unconfirmed, and that a real, existing transfer mechanism exists to resolve exactly this kind of gap.

functions.name: Containment
functions.definition: Names a structural harm mechanism so it can no longer operate invisibly.
functions.match_note: The SHM Gate names 6 mechanisms as operative, including two candidate mechanisms (Jurisdictional Void, Circular Deflection Loop) this case surfaced that were not previously in the catalogue.

functions.name: Temporal Inversion
functions.definition: Time loads onto the institution, not the citizen.
functions.match_note: AR-014 (Temporal Analysis) documents the governance gap persisting since the laneway's 1892 origin - 134 years on current evidence - with the trajectory explicitly classified DEGRADING rather than improving with time.

functions.name: Reflexive Audit
functions.definition: MAYHEM's own primitives applied to MAYHEM itself.
functions.match_note: During ingestion, this repository independently re-checked the original AR-012's claim that 5 mechanisms matched the catalogue and found only 3 genuinely did (the other 2 became the candidate mechanisms above) - MAYHEM's own evidentiary discipline applied to MAYHEM's own prior output, not taken on trust.

functions.name: Impossibility Demonstration
functions.definition: Converts closure of every remediation surface into evidence of structural impossibility of self-remediation.
functions.status: Not a clean match - remediation is shown available, not impossible
functions.match_note: AR-010 (Self-Remediation Assessment) is the closest match, but concludes the opposite of impossibility: transfer remains available to Council and initiable by Crown Lands, simply unused. The finding is non-action despite availability, not closure of every surface. Not claimed as this function.

functions.name: Divergence Preservation
functions.definition: Preserves disagreement rather than silently reconciling it.
functions.match_note: CTR-0001 (Council's Crown-land basis for its disclaimer is unverified) and CTR-0002 (the case's own advocacy material contradicts itself on whether documents were already sent) are both preserved as open, unresolved findings rather than resolved by assumption.

citizen_tools.name: The Evidence Register
citizen_tools.definition: A blank, paper-ready, append-only template for documenting evidence.
citizen_tools.match_note: 51 evidence items, append-only, three independently re-confirmed against the actual Crown Lands policy PDF during ingestion.

citizen_tools.name: The Advocacy Package
citizen_tools.definition: The complete investigation output combined with recipient guidance.
citizen_tools.match_note: Built and live, naming who has standing, how to submit the notice and GIPA application, and how to log responses.

citizen_tools.name: Five-Step Primary Source Verification
citizen_tools.definition: Teaches any person to verify a finding against its primary source.
citizen_tools.match_note: Present in the Advocacy Package with a real worked example: the Crown Lands policy PDF was directly fetched and its transfer-eligibility criterion confirmed verbatim.

citizen_tools.name: Recipient Routing
citizen_tools.definition: Names bodies with standing, their legislative basis, and the remedy addressed to each.
citizen_tools.match_note: The Enforcement Notice routes four remedies across three recipients (Council, the MP, Crown Lands), each with a stated basis for standing.

citizen_tools.name: Lived Experience Documentation Protocol
citizen_tools.definition: Teaches affected people to document their own experience as primary evidence.
citizen_tools.status: Partially demonstrated, not built as a standalone artifact
citizen_tools.match_note: EV-0002/EV-0003 are real instances of this, but no standalone protocol document exists for another resident to follow.

citizen_tools.name: Reclassification Recognition Training
citizen_tools.definition: Teaches recognition of institutional reclassification patterns in real time.
citizen_tools.match_note: Not evidenced - no training artifact in this case's built material.

citizen_tools.name: Institutional Response Log
citizen_tools.definition: Logs every institutional response - date, form, content, classification.
citizen_tools.match_note: The Advocacy Package's logging section provides the template; no confirmed log entries exist, and whether the notice has even been sent remains an open, preserved contradiction (CTR-0002, Q-0005).

citizen_tools.name: Harm Narration Construction
citizen_tools.definition: Constructs evidence-anchored harm narration for different audiences.
citizen_tools.status: Not built as a repository artifact
citizen_tools.match_note: A press release existed in the original preserved material but was not built into this repository as a live page.

citizen_tools.name: Onward Training Capability
citizen_tools.definition: Designed to be passed on by anyone who has worked through it.
citizen_tools.match_note: The Advocacy Package is written for a reader with no prior MAYHEM knowledge, requiring no specialist background.

citizen_tools.name: Operator Curriculum
citizen_tools.definition: Trains operators to run MAYHEM investigations across competency grades.
citizen_tools.status: Not applicable to a single investigation
citizen_tools.match_note: This is a methodology-level tool, not something a single case produces.

citizen_tools.name: Paper-Ready Templates
citizen_tools.definition: Working instruments applying the methodology with no digital dependency.
citizen_tools.status: Not distinctly built for this case
citizen_tools.match_note: Not evidenced as a case-specific artifact beyond the general Advocacy Package content.

citizen_tools.name: Non-Allegatory Framing
citizen_tools.definition: Describes system behaviour, never attributes intent or motivation.
citizen_tools.match_note: Every path in DFAPTA and every mechanism in the SHM Gate describes documented conduct and absence, never council's or Crown Lands' intent - explicitly stated as deliberate framing in the case's own overreach_controls.

citizen_tools.name: Federation as Mutual Legibility
citizen_tools.definition: Multiple independent registers whose convergence produces legibility no single one can.
citizen_tools.match_note: Unlike DFAPTI-TA-FF-2026-00001, this case does not cross-reference another case's register as part of its own findings.

citizen_tools.name: Temporal Accumulation as Citizen Power
citizen_tools.definition: Absence and delay become evidence that strengthens the citizen's case over time.
citizen_tools.match_note: Directly demonstrated by AR-014/Function 8 above - 134 years of non-resolution is itself the evidentiary record, not a weakening of the case.

citizen_tools.name: Cross-Domain Pattern Detection
citizen_tools.definition: Surfaces convergence across health, housing, disability and other domains for the same person.
citizen_tools.match_note: Single-domain (Crown land tenure and maintenance governance); does not cross into other governance domains.

citizen_tools.name: Community Evidence Aggregation
citizen_tools.definition: Multiple people's accounts of the same system, aggregated without institutional processing.
citizen_tools.match_note: The evidence base is one resident's direct observation plus institutional/documentary records, not multiple aggregated resident accounts.

citizen_tools.name: Structural Literacy as Preventative Tool
citizen_tools.definition: Lets a citizen recognise a harm mechanism before it completes.
citizen_tools.status: Not evidenced as forward-preventative for this case
citizen_tools.match_note: This case's findings are retrospective, documenting a 134-year-old gap, not applied to catch a harm still in progress.

citizen_tools.name: Parallel Verification as Democratic Infrastructure
citizen_tools.definition: Any completed investigation can be independently re-verified using the same methodology.
citizen_tools.match_note: This repository independently re-fetched and confirmed the Crown Lands policy PDF and independently re-checked AR-012's mechanism-match claims, finding the original overclaimed two of five - a real instance of parallel verification correcting the original finding.

citizen_tools.name: Yield Without Enforcement
citizen_tools.definition: Chain completion is determined by yield delivery, not enforcement notice production.
citizen_tools.status: Active - the organising principle of this page
citizen_tools.match_note: This case's DFAPTA, Lattice Atlas, and SHM Gate already deliver legibility and structural visibility regardless of whether the Enforcement Notice was ever sent - a question this case itself leaves open (CTR-0002).

not_claimed: This gate does not claim every catalogue entry above is fully or perfectly delivered - several are marked 'not evidenced' or 'not a clean match' rather than forced into a positive claim.

This gate does not claim intent by any institution named in this case. Every assessment above describes what this case's own material demonstrates, consistent with this case's non-allegatory framing throughout.
This gate does not re-verify the underlying EV- items cited as anchors - their verification status remains exactly as recorded in this case's own evidence register.
This is this repository's own reading of the catalogue against this case's material, not a claim of the operator's final or complete assessment.
